# testdata — vendored reference corpus

Generated by `cargo xtask vendor` (crates/xtask). Do not edit by hand.

* Source: https://github.com/structurizr/structurizr (monorepo), commit `ad34036`,
licensed Apache-2.0 — attribution for all vendored files stays with the Structurizr project.
* Goldens: generated with the unified application binary **structurizr 2026.10.26**
(library 6.2.4) via `cargo xtask oracle gen`; the four `structurizr.inspection.*` violation
counters the reference app injects on load are stripped at generation time (see
`xtask::normalize_reference_output` and `agents/plan/PROGRESS.md`). Requires Java 21.
Goldens are byte-faithful otherwise — including the ABSENT trailing newline the
reference pretty-printer emits. `golden/plantuml/<fixture>/` holds the M2-d
diagram goldens (`cargo xtask oracle gen --plantuml --fixture <fixture>`):
the oracle's `structurizr-<id>-<key>.puml` (+ `-key` legend) files, RAW — the
diagram writer injects no harness artifacts, so nothing is normalized. The
corpus is the A/B sweep SAME set minus vacuous (viewless) fixtures; compared
by the Category-A test `crates/oxidizr-api/tests/export_plantuml_goldens.rs`.
* `dsl/` — 107 DSL fixtures (reference test resources; P1 parse corpus).
* `probes/` — hand-written oracle-probe fixtures (WRITE-CATALOG witnesses; see
  `agents/plan/build/WRITE-CATALOG.md`); goldens for them are generated the same way.
  `m3-order.dsl` (P1-M3a: key tables, sorts, computed names, HashMap properties);
  `m3b-defaults.json` (P1-M3b: JSON→JSON reader defaults — healthCheck header
  bucket order, healthChecks/automaticLayout bean initializers, nullable enum
  bindings, color normalization). The `m3b-defaults` golden is raw oracle bytes
  minus the `structurizr.inspection.*` counters and the emptied `properties`
  entry; probe inputs must stay re-readable by the reference itself (a
  healthCheck with a null `name`/`url` NPEs the reference READ).
* `read-corpus/` + `validation/` — 21 JSON workspaces (back-compat read + validation rules,
  from `structurizr-client/src/test/resources`). In `validation/`, 15 fixtures must fail
  `hydrate()` with the reference message and 1
  (`TopLevelDeploymentNodeNamesAreNotUniqueButTheyExistInDifferentEnvironments`) must
  LOAD — the reference test name says `exceptionNotThrown` (uniqueness is per name+environment).
* `golden/` — committed reference goldens (byte-parity gate; regenerate sparingly).

## Deferred fixtures (D7 — `!docs`/`!adrs`, excluded from P1–P3 parse/golden gates)

These fixtures parse-statement-form only until the importers land in Phase 4 (P4-D13);
loading them yields OXZ-5003. P4 retires this list. The machine-readable corpus
classification (every corpus file: clean or registered first-error + code) is the
`KNOWN_ERRORS` register in `crates/oxidizr-dsl/tests/m4_fixtures.rs` — entries are
retired there as the milestones land (M5 extends, P4 importers/renderers).

- `dsl/big-bank-plc/model/internet-banking-system/details.dsl`
- `dsl/decisions/workspace.dsl`
- `dsl/docs/workspace.dsl`
- `dsl/include/model/software-system/model.dsl`
